lead: A confirmation bubble: click an element and a small bubble beside it asks "Are you sure?". It doesn't interrupt the page and is lighter than a dialog, suited to inline delete or disable actions. `onConfirm` can be async. For a strong, full-screen confirmation use [Confirm Dialog](/confirm-dialog).

async.title: Async confirm
async.left: Items left: `{n}` (after confirming, the request takes 900 ms and the button spins meanwhile)
